description: This file declares the WifiManagerScan class, which manages WiFi scan operations such as starting and stopping scans, and handling WiFi scan data asynchronously within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It provides methods for initializing/deinitializing the scanner, starting/stopping scans, and filtering available SSIDs based on parameters.

classes.name: WifiManagerScan
classes.description: Encapsulates WiFi scanning functionality including managing scan processes, handling event callbacks, and filtering scan results.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes WiFi scanning with the given service shell.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts a WiFi scan with specified parameters and provides a response with the scan results.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops an ongoing WiFi scan and updates the response accordingly.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves available SSIDs asynchronously based on parameters.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsyncIncr
methods.description: Incrementally retrieves available SSIDs based on parameters.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles events related to WiFi scanning.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Applies filtering criteria to WiFi scan results based on the filter settings.
